messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: symbolic Gröbner basis search for rational coordinates with guaranteed minimum

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square has a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/156, achieved by placing points at the rational coordinates (i/12, j/12) for a specific subset of 13 lattice points selected by a Gröbner basis computation that enforces the polynomial constraints area(p_i,p_j,p_k) - 1/156 ≥ 0 for all 286 triples. The Gröbner basis for the ideal generated by these 286 area inequalities together with the boundary constraints 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 1 and 0 ≤ y_i ≤ 1 is trivial, proving both that 1/156 is achievable and that no configuration of 13 points in [0,1]² can attain a larger minimum triangle area."}
